## Research interests

My research interests center on causal inference and applied
econometrics, particularly difference-in-differences designs, panel
and longitudinal data analysis, and combining NLP/machine-learning
methods with causal statistical inference to study questions in
economics and technology (e.g., algorithmic amplification and content
bias on social media platforms).

## Skills

Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib), R, Stata, SQL,
machine learning / NLP pipelines, causal inference
(difference-in-differences), panel/longitudinal data analysis,
regression analysis, data pipelines, API integration, database design
(PostgreSQL, MSSQL), data visualization, Git
